**Goal.** Reproduce Hefley's 1-D examples yourself, so the three specifications (second-order + BLUP, eigenvector basis, kernel basis) are things you've built rather than equations you've read. Your own version of Fig. 2 is the deliverable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Get Supporting Information Appendices S1–S5; skim Examples 1–3
- [ ] Simulate a 1-D Gaussian-correlation process in `sim/toy1d.R`
- [ ] Fit three ways and plot against the truth (my Fig. 2)
- [ ] Derivation: QΛ^{1/2}(QΛ^{1/2})′ = R, numerically then by proof
- [ ] Derivation: Eq. 15 from the conditional-normal formula

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("../sim/_load.R")
library(ggplot2)
```

## 1. Get the appendices

Download Appendices S1–S5 from the Ecology Supporting Information. Skim Examples 1–3 and note which R code corresponds to which figure.

**Done when:** the appendix PDFs and code are saved locally, and you know which appendix covers Fig. 2.
